root_cause: The fix for the TOUCH-from-script bug swapped current_client for executing_client in a dereference chain without adding the same NULL-guard that was already present for current_client. server.executing_client is not guaranteed to be set in all code paths that reach lookupKey() (notably the blocked-client unblocking path), so the missing null check leads to a NULL pointer dereference.
findings: In lookupKey(), the CLIENT NO-TOUCH check was changed to use server.executing_client->cmd->proc instead of server.current_client->cmd->proc, in order to correctly detect the TOUCH command when it is invoked via scripts/RM_Call. However, the code only null-checks server.current_client before entering the branch; it never checks whether server.executing_client itself is NULL before dereferencing it.
